title: Roswell crash and Stringfield's Marcel interview

tellings.quote: and he was one of the per first people to interview and publish his interview with Jesse Marcel Senior.

plain: After the 1947 crash near Roswell, New Mexico, which some believe was a spacecraft, a UFO researcher named Leonard Stringfield was among the very first people to interview Jesse Marcel Sr., the Army officer who handled the debris, and to publish that interview. The UFO historian Richard Dolan tells Michels this, without naming a source, and also names the researcher Stanton Friedman in connection with it. If true, Stringfield's work would be one of the early steps that brought Marcel's account to the public.
